description: The full text of an article, for when lookup()'s summary is not enough — sections as a JSON array, infobox as key/value facts, no HTML or wikitext to parse. Pass `sections` to pull only the parts you need (e.g. ["Early life"]) and `max_chars` to cap the payload; both exist because a long article will otherwise flood your context.

corpus.description: Which corpus to read from. Defaults to wikipedia.

max_chars.description: Optional cap on total section text returned.

sections.description: Optional section names to include (substring match, case-insensitive). Omit for the whole article.

name: article
